scorecard.analysis_type: Class-Separated Distribution Drift & Covariate Shift Scorecard

methodology.psi_bins: 10 quantile bins derived from reference training partition; exact [0, 1] categorical bins for binary features
methodology.wasserstein_metric: First Wasserstein distance (L1 earth mover distance)

observational_diagnostics.legitimate_partition_shift: Empirical quantification reveals severe covariate shift across legitimate web URLs: 11 of 18 features exhibit severe PSI (>= 0.25), led by SpacialCharRatioInURL (PSI = 6.79), NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL (PSI = 4.97), NoOfSubDomain (PSI = 2.28), NoOfEqualsInURL (PSI = 2.04), NoOfQMarkInURL (PSI = 1.99), URLLength (PSI = 1.34), and DomainLength (PSI = 1.24). This reflects the empirical disparity between the PhiUSIIL benign training distribution (where 100% lacked query parameters and mean special characters = 1.25) and authentic live operational routes that routinely possess multi-level path slashes, query parameters, and subdomains.
observational_diagnostics.phishing_partition_shift: In contrast to the legitimate partition, phishing URLs exhibit substantially milder covariate drift: mean PSI is 0.1877 (vs 1.3280 for legitimate). Only 5 features show severe PSI in phishing, primarily IsHTTPS (PSI = 0.33, reflecting external phishing having 79.2% TLS adoption vs 52.1% in historical training), NoOfSubDomain (PSI = 0.79), TLDLength (PSI = 0.46), and NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL (PSI = 0.57). Query parameters in phishing (NoOfEqualsInURL PSI = 0.06, NoOfQMarkInURL PSI = 0.02) show negligible drift because phishing URLs in both environments consistently utilized query strings.
observational_diagnostics.asymmetric_drift_implication: The observed covariate shift is highly asymmetric: legitimate URL structures diverged dramatically from the training baseline (mean D_KS = 0.306, mean PSI = 1.393), while phishing URL structures remained comparatively stable (mean D_KS = 0.134, mean PSI = 0.198). This asymmetric shift is consistent with the ensemble's high false-positive rate on benign URLs.
